records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Greetings.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Приветствую.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Рад знакомству.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Are you the culprit of this wrongdoing?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Это вы совершили это преступление?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: In fact, do not reveal the answer just yet.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Впрочем, пока не отвечайте.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Special Agent Thomas Amog.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Позвольте представиться. Специальный агент Томас Амог.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I am currently investigating a most heinous reverse murder.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я расследую чудовищное убийство наоборот.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Yes.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Да.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Observe the bloodstains on the ground, my dear.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Взгляните на пятна крови на земле, друг мой.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It is clear that a murder is about to occur.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Очевидно, здесь вот-вот произойдёт убийство.

style_anchors.source: a murder is about to occur

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Someone is going to die here, it is inevitable.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Кто-то здесь погибнет. Это неизбежно.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Might you assist me in solving this case?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Не поможете мне раскрыть это дело?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Perfect, here is a Detective Scanner, take it.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Прекрасно. Вот детективный сканер, возьмите.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I suggest utilizing it on various objects within this abode to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Советую просканировать разные предметы в этом доме: улики подскажут, где находится несчастная жертва.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Here is the scanner.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вот сканер.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Are you sure you used the scanner on everything in this house?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы уверены, что просканировали всё в этом доме?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: This part is crucial for the investigation.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Это крайне важно для расследования.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Use the Detective Scanner to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Используйте детективный сканер: улики подскажут, где находится несчастная жертва.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I believe we have gathered all the necessary clues to unravel this mystery.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Полагаю, мы собрали все улики, необходимые для разгадки этой тайны.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Well done my dear!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Отличная работа, друг мой!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: However, the question remains, where ought we to begin our investigation?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Но остаётся вопрос: с чего нам начать расследование?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: The bouquet was crafted with love, that much is certain.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Букет составлен с любовью, это несомненно.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Well done, my dear, for deducing as much.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Браво, друг мой! Прекрасный вывод.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: We must make haste and locate the florist at once. Time is of the essence in this matter.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Нужно немедленно найти цветочницу. В этом деле нельзя терять ни минуты.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Marcia, she must be the lover.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Марсия... Должно быть, это его возлюбленная.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Ah, it appears Master Tactician Fink is the culprit.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Ага, похоже, преступник — мастер-тактик Финк.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Most intriguing.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Весьма любопытно.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Come, let us make haste to the Colosseum and apprehend him.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скорее в Колизей! Нужно его задержать.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: The culprit is right there, let's interrogate him.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Преступник прямо перед нами. Давайте его допросим.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Marvelous! We have discovered the instrument of the crime.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Великолепно! Мы нашли орудие преступления.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: However, the location of Ramero remains unknown.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Однако местонахождение Рамеро по-прежнему неизвестно.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Yes, have you managed to uncover any promising leads?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Да. Удалось найти какие-нибудь зацепки?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Ah-ha!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Ага!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Yes, Ramero is probably in search of the final piece to complete his wedding ring.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Да, Рамеро, вероятно, ищет последнюю деталь для обручального кольца.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I suspect he has visited the local blacksmith to obtain the necessary jewel.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Полагаю, он зашёл к местному кузнецу за нужным драгоценным камнем.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let's head right there!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Немедленно отправимся туда!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I am quite certain that Mr. Ramero can be found at the blacksmith's shop at this very moment.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я почти уверен, что господин Рамеро сейчас находится в мастерской кузнеца.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let's head there! It is near the mines.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Отправимся туда! Это рядом с шахтами.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: We found the Blacksmith, but no sign of Ramero, let's ask them.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Кузнеца нашли, а Рамеро нигде не видно. Давайте расспросим кузнеца.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Another "dead" end...
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Опять «мёртвый» след...

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: But we are right on his tail. I can feel it.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Но мы идём по его пятам. Я это чувствую.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Me too. Let's think.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я тоже. Давайте подумаем.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Good initiative, my dear friend.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Хорошая мысль, друг мой.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: When one is stuck in a difficult situation, it is often wise to return to the beginning and re-examine all the evidence.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Когда дело заходит в тупик, стоит вернуться к началу и заново изучить все улики.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I believe we may have overlooked something of great importance at Mr. Ramero's residence.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Полагаю, мы упустили нечто очень важное в доме господина Рамеро.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let us make haste and go back to his house at once to see if we can uncover any new clues.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скорее вернёмся в его дом и поищем новые улики.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: See if you can find anything extra in the house!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Поищите в доме что-нибудь ещё!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Did you find anything?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Что-нибудь нашли?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Indeed!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Именно!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: How could we have been so blind?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Как же мы этого не заметили?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Joliet is undoubtedly buying the dress as we speak!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Джолиет наверняка покупает платье прямо сейчас!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let's hurry to Taylor swift-ly!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скорее к Тейлор — быстро-быстро!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: There is Joliet. Let's ask her what she knows.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вот Джолиет. Спросим, что ей известно.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Poor Joliet...
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Бедная Джолиет...

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let's leave her alone and go find Ramero at his house.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Оставим её в покое и поищем Рамеро у него дома.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Looks like Ramero barricaded himself.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Похоже, Рамеро забаррикадировался.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Yes, I don't think we can enter now.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Да, теперь нам вряд ли удастся войти.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: The barricade is far too sturdy to break through on our own.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Баррикада слишком прочная: сами мы её не пробьём.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: There is only one person in the Rift who possesses the strength necessary to break through it.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: В Разломе есть лишь один человек, которому хватит сил её пробить.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: But I fear he is often too busy with other matters to be of assistance to us...
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Но боюсь, он слишком занят другими делами, чтобы нам помочь...

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: The individual in question is none other than Wizardman.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я говорю не о ком ином, как о Волшебникмене.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Admittedly, his methods can be a tad unpredictable.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Признаюсь, его методы порой непредсказуемы.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Nonetheless, we should call upon his help.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: И всё же стоит позвать его на помощь.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You should try to shout "Help Wizardman!"
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Попробуйте крикнуть «Help Wizardman!» — это значит «Помоги, Волшебникмен!».

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It's Wizardman! He has truly arrived!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Это Волшебникмен! Он действительно пришёл!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Ramero is right there!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Рамеро прямо там!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: He'll be dead soon!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скоро он будет мёртв!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: We are almost at the end of our journey.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Мы почти у цели.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: We have found the murder weapon, the victim, and the place where the crime was committed.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Мы нашли орудие убийства, жертву и место преступления.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It has to be done.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Это необходимо сделать.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Naturally, this is where the investigation leads.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Разумеется. К этому и привело расследование.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You are almost there, my friend.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы почти у цели, друг мой.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You can do this.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: У вас получится.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Come on, use the murder weapon.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Ну же, используйте орудие убийства.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It is time.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Пора.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You have solved the case!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы раскрыли дело!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: But I must ask, why did you kill him?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Но я должен спросить: зачем вы его убили?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: These reverse murders always have a motive.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: У таких убийств наоборот всегда есть мотив.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Did you kill him to steal his ring of love?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы убили его, чтобы украсть кольцо любви?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I see. Well, take it then.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Понятно. Что ж, тогда забирайте.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You have completed your goal and the case is now closed.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы добились своего, а дело теперь закрыто.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I hope we get to work together again!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Надеюсь, мы ещё поработаем вместе!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: One can hope you won't have to investigate my own reverse murder.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Остаётся надеяться, что вам не придётся расследовать моё собственное убийство наоборот.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Do you need to find Ramero's Ring again?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вам снова нужно найти кольцо Рамеро?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I do remember you, although I am uncertain if we have met in this timeline.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я вас помню, хотя не уверен, что мы встречались в этой временной линии.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: The one of Ramero.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Убийство Рамеро.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I came to this vantage point in hopes to see the murderer.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я пришёл на эту смотровую площадку в надежде увидеть убийцу.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Yet, I must confess, my investigations have yet to bear fruit.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Но, признаюсь, пока расследование не принесло результатов.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Indeed, I have inspected his house, but perhaps a fresh pair of eyes might reveal what I have missed.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Да, я осмотрел его дом, но свежий взгляд, возможно, заметит то, что я упустил.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let us proceed to Ramero's house together.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Пойдёмте вместе в дом Рамеро.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: We might find more clues at Ramero's house.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: В доме Рамеро могут найтись новые улики.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Indeed my dear, it must be done.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Именно, друг мой. Это необходимо.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: We should employ a detective scanner to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Нужно воспользоваться детективным сканером: улики подскажут, где находится несчастная жертва.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: The bouquet, yes! That appears to be true, impressive.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Букет, точно! Похоже на правду. Впечатляет.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Well done my dear, for deducing as much.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Браво, друг мой! Прекрасный вывод.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Have you uncovered more clues, my dear?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Нашли новые улики, друг мой?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: What revelations did the Master Tactician Fink bestow upon you?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Что же поведал вам мастер-тактик Финк?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Shall we pursue that avenue then?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Тогда пойдём по этому следу?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Indeed, it is an exhausting endeavor.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Да, это изнурительное занятие.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Directly to Joliet at Taylor's shop? A judicious choice, indeed.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Сразу к Джолиет в магазин Тейлор? И впрямь разумное решение.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It is plausible that Ramero sought out Joliet one final time before his untimely demise.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Возможно, Рамеро хотел в последний раз увидеть Джолиет перед безвременной кончиной.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let us hasten our steps to Taylor's shop without delay!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Без промедления отправимся в магазин Тейлор!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: We found Ramero before the murderer could.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Мы нашли Рамеро раньше убийцы.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Yet, something is amiss, as a murder was foretold to occur at his house.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Но что-то не сходится: убийство должно произойти у него дома.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It is destined that someone will perish where these bloodstains lay.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Судьбой предрешено: кто-то погибнет там, где лежат эти пятна крови.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Every word has reached my ears.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я слышал каждое слово.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let's quickly make our way to Ramero's house to barricade it.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скорее в дом Рамеро! Нужно его забаррикадировать.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: The murderer hasn't arrived yet!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Убийца ещё не пришёл!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Let's move quickly and help Ramero!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скорее поможем Рамеро!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Excellent work!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Отличная работа!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: This barricade is exceptionally strong.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Эта баррикада необычайно прочна.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I can think of only one person who might manage to destroy it in the Rift!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Во всём Разломе я знаю лишь одного человека, способного её разрушить!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Expecting a breach soon? Then we must gear up.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Думаете, скоро прорвутся? Тогда нужно подготовиться.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Quickly, find a hiding spot until the murderer makes their move!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скорее найдите укрытие и ждите, пока убийца начнёт действовать!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You will need to defeat them before they kill Ramero!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вам придётся победить убийцу, прежде чем он убьёт Рамеро!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Hurry, find a hiding place before the murderer breaches the entrance!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скорее найдите укрытие, пока убийца не пробился внутрь!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Quickly now, take cover in the corner!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Быстрее, спрячьтесь в углу!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Perfect, stay there hidden, until you see the murderer attempt on Ramero's life!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Отлично, оставайтесь в укрытии, пока убийца не нападёт на Рамеро!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Now's the time! Defend Ramero with all you've got!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Пора! Защищайте Рамеро изо всех сил!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Hurry, take down the murderer now!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Скорее, остановите убийцу!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Act fast! Bring the murderer to justice immediately!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Действуйте быстро! Немедленно покарайте убийцу!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You have solved the case.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы раскрыли дело.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: But I must ask, why did you choose to protect Ramero?
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Но я должен спросить: почему вы решили защитить Рамеро?

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Very few people would harm themselves rather than endanger another.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Мало кто готов навредить себе, лишь бы не подвергать опасности другого.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Such valor is most commendable, truly.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Такая отвага поистине достойна восхищения.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I cannot say for certain, only you can uncover such answers.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Не могу сказать наверняка. Только вы можете найти ответ.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Alas, it appears you had transformed into the murderer.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Увы, похоже, вы сами стали убийцей.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It was an inevitable turn of events, justice found its way.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Такой поворот был неизбежен. Справедливость восторжествовала.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Difficult to predict.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Трудно предсказать.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Depending on the timeline, this might be your fate.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: В иной временной линии вас может ждать такая судьба.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Perhaps, however, that was a just end.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Хотя, возможно, такой конец был справедливым.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You crossed a line when you tried to end Ramero's life.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы перешли черту, когда попытались лишить Рамеро жизни.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It was an indefensible act.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Этому поступку нет оправдания.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: One indeed reaps what they sow.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Что посеешь, то и пожнёшь.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You committed the deeds yourself.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы сами всё это совершили.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: And for that, you earned my respect.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: И этим заслужили моё уважение.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: However you are correct, it is likely nothing would have happened had I not placed this blood on the ground.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Но вы правы: скорее всего, ничего бы не случилось, не разлей я здесь кровь.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: One cannot investigate a reverse murder without first creating a murder scenario, dear.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Нельзя расследовать убийство наоборот, не создав сначала условия для убийства, друг мой.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It is elementary.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Элементарно.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Look there!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Посмотрите туда!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Joliet has just arrived, and she seems quite delighted.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Только что пришла Джолиет и, кажется, очень довольна.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You ought to speak with her, it could be enlightening!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Поговорите с ней: возможно, узнаете что-нибудь интересное!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Another case solved!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Ещё одно дело раскрыто!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Allow me to introduce myself, I am Special Agent Thomas Amog.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Позвольте представиться: специальный агент Томас Амог.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Someone is going to die right here.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Кто-то погибнет прямо здесь.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Right now.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Прямо сейчас.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: On this spot.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: На этом самом месте.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It is inevitable.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Это неизбежно.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I already found a possible motive.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я уже нашёл возможный мотив.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: This Wallet, that I found in my pocket.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вот этот кошелёк, который я нашёл у себя в кармане.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: You know what to do.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Вы знаете, что делать.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Someone is going to die here, right now, it is inevitable.
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Кто-то погибнет здесь прямо сейчас. Это неизбежно.

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: It hurts!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Больно!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I don't want to die!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Я не хочу умирать!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Please!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Прошу вас!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: I have many more cases to solve!
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Мне ещё столько дел нужно раскрыть!

records.speaker: Detective Amog
records.source: [NPC] Detective Amog: Another case solved...
records.translation: [NPC] Detective Amog: Ещё одно дело раскрыто...

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: I am Oruo The Almighty. I have lived many lives. I have ascended.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Я Оруо Всемогущий. Я прожил множество жизней. Я вознёсся.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: I have control over the Blessing of Time.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Мне подвластно Благословение времени.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: In this place where time has no meaning, I created a zone where time is everything.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Здесь, где время ничего не значит, я создал место, где время решает всё.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: It is the only room in The Rift where your body will feel the effects of Time.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Это единственная комната в Разломе, где твоё тело ощутит действие времени.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: In this Time Chamber, you will be able to train and get stronger.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: В этой Временной камере ты сможешь тренироваться и становиться сильнее.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Entry demands 5,000 Motes, a trivial sum for a taste of eternity.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: За вход нужно заплатить 5,000 пылинок — ничтожную цену за прикосновение к вечности.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Though beware, for your ф Rift Time shall deplete twice as fast.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Но помни: твоё ф время Разлома будет истекать вдвое быстрее.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: What say you?
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Что скажешь?

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: You only delay the inevitable.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Ты лишь оттягиваешь неизбежное.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: A deity, you ponder?
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Думаешь, я божество?

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: I am but a seeker who stumbled upon the Blessing of Time hidden within the veils of this dimension.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Я лишь искатель, обнаруживший Благословение времени, сокрытое за пеленой этого измерения.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: My partner, Sun Gecko, and I discovered the Blessing of Time together.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Мы с моим товарищем, Солнечным гекконом, вместе открыли Благословение времени.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: The fates decreed that only one could wield its power.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Судьба решила, что владеть этой силой сможет лишь один из нас.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: It was I who was chosen, and thus I crafted this chamber so he could train against people such as yourself.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Избран был я. Потому я и создал эту камеру, чтобы он мог тренироваться с такими, как ты.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: He must become stronger, in preparation for a hardship that has yet to come.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Он должен стать сильнее, чтобы подготовиться к грядущему испытанию.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: The Precursors, you inquire?
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Ты спрашиваешь о Предтечах?

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Through the Blessing of Time I have earned the knowledge and memories of the ancient God of Time.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Благодаря Благословению времени я обрёл знания и воспоминания древнего Бога времени.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: I have seen what no man has seen.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Я видел то, чего не видел ни один человек.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: The shadows of their return soon loom over us; we must stand prepared.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Тень их скорого возвращения уже нависла над нами. Мы должны быть готовы.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Julian seeks me, yet he knows not the full scope of the web woven by Shen, his own master.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Джулиан ищет меня, но даже не представляет, насколько обширна сеть, сплетённая его собственным наставником Шеном.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: If he finds his way through the labyrinth of time to my domain, it will be my duty to enlighten him.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Если он пройдёт сквозь лабиринт времени в мои владения, я должен буду открыть ему глаза.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: I will unveil the intricate plots of Shen and his organization.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Я раскрою хитросплетения замыслов Шена и его организации.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: That knowledge, crucial and potent, may well tilt the scales of Destiny.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Это знание, столь важное и могущественное, может склонить чашу весов Судьбы.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Magnificent. You have vanquished Sun Gecko, not a feat to be understated.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Великолепно. Ты одолел Солнечного геккона — немалое достижение.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: While moments have passed for you, weeks have slipped by for Sun Gecko.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Для тебя прошли мгновения, а для Солнечного геккона — недели.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: He lies in rest, rejuvenated and eager for your return.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Он отдыхает, восстанавливает силы и с нетерпением ждёт твоего возвращения.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: The price for reentry remains at 5,000 Motes.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Цена повторного входа прежняя: 5,000 пылинок.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Dare you pay it?
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Осмелишься заплатить?

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Your strength prevails, but your journey has only just begun.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Ты победил благодаря своей силе, но твой путь только начинается.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: You are now granted access to Time Chamber Modifiers and the Sun Gecko Essence Shop.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Теперь тебе доступны модификаторы Временной камеры и магазин эссенции Солнечного геккона.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: The power of Sun Gecko is only limited by your own resolve.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Сила Солнечного геккона ограничена лишь твоей решимостью.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Work the Modifiers of the Time Chamber, and your strength will know no bounds.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Используй модификаторы Временной камеры, и твоя сила не будет знать границ.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Magnificent, you have vanquished Sun Gecko, not a feat to be understated.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Великолепно, ты одолел Солнечного геккона — немалое достижение.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Shall you challenge him again?
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Бросишь ему вызов снова?

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Once more you have triumphed over Sun Gecko. Such perseverance is rare, even in Tales of old.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Ты вновь одолел Солнечного геккона. Такое упорство редко встретишь даже в древних сказаниях.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: A third victory! You have surpassed even my expectations.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Третья победа! Ты превзошёл даже мои ожидания.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Though Sun Gecko's power grows more daunting, you have found a way through once again.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Солнечный геккон становится всё могущественнее, но ты снова нашёл способ победить.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Sun Gecko's intensity thundered across the battlefield, yet your will stood firm, forging a triumph that whispers of greatness yet untold.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Мощь Солнечного геккона сотрясала поле боя, но твоя воля не дрогнула. Эта победа — предвестие ещё не воспетого величия.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Sun Gecko pressed against the very limits of mortal endurance, yet today you sculpted a victory from raw chaos.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Солнечный геккон испытал пределы выносливости смертного, но сегодня ты выковал победу из первозданного хаоса.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: As Sun Gecko unleashed deeper reserves of power, you carved a new mark of valor into the shifting sands of time.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Солнечный геккон раскрывал всё новые запасы силы, а ты вновь запечатлел свою доблесть в зыбких песках времени.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: At the apex of Sun Gecko's power, when all seemed unattainable, you forged a moment of legend that will echo through ages.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: На пике могущества Солнечного геккона, когда победа казалась недостижимой, ты создал легенду, которая будет звучать сквозь века.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Your trials here have woven a portion of the Blessing of Time into the very fibers of your being.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Пройденные здесь испытания вплели частицу Благословения времени в саму ткань твоего существа.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Stronger you stand, bearing the vigor of both this realm and yours.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Ты стал сильнее, вобрав мощь и этого мира, и своего.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Feel the surge of power coursing through your veins, a testament to your enduring spirit and the time spent within these walls.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Ощути силу, текущую по твоим венам. Она свидетельствует о стойкости твоего духа и времени, проведённом в этих стенах.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: You have now absorbed a second measure of the Blessing of Time.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Теперь ты вобрал вторую частицу Благословения времени.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: You have now received the final Blessing of Time.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Теперь ты получил последнее Благословение времени.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Congratulations on mastering the trials of my Time Chamber.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Поздравляю с прохождением испытаний моей Временной камеры.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: With the final Blessing, our contract is fulfilled, thrice granted, and thrice received.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: С последним Благословением наш договор исполнен: трижды даровано и трижды принято.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Rest now, for you have earned it.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Теперь отдохни. Ты это заслужил.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: With less than 120ф Rift Time remaining, your risk outweighs the reward.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Когда остаётся менее 120ф времени Разлома, риск превышает награду.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: I cannot permit you to enter.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Я не могу позволить тебе войти.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Oruo's Time Chamber demands more than just fleeting moments.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Временная камера Оруо требует большего, чем несколько мимолётных мгновений.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Your motes purse is not as strong as your will.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Твой кошелёк с пылинками не так силён, как твоя воля.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Oruo's Time Chamber demands sacrifice.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Временная камера Оруо требует жертвы.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: In order to access the Time Chamber, you must be closer to its entrance. Please move closer to the Continuum.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Чтобы попасть во Временную камеру, нужно подойти к её входу. Подойди ближе к Континууму.

records.speaker: Oruo The Almighty
records.source: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Interesting. The Time Chamber is not currently available.
records.translation: [NPC] Oruo The Almighty: Любопытно. Сейчас Временная камера недоступна.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: I talked to Swoop the other day, he explained a lot of interesting Foraging Mechanics to me.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Недавно говорил со Свупом. Он рассказал мне много интересного о механиках собирательства.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Perhaps you should talk to him too, he’s at the entrance of the Village!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Может, и тебе стоит с ним поговорить? Он у входа в деревню!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Greetings!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Приветствую!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: I'm David Hunterborough, the island's Hunting Specialist.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Я Дэвид Хантерборо, местный специалист по охоте.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Hunting has been around for eons, perfected by advanced beings known as the Precursors.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Охота существует целую вечность. Её довели до совершенства высокоразвитые существа — Предтечи.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: They discovered that within every creature lies a power unique to its kind.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Они обнаружили, что в каждом существе скрыта сила, свойственная только его виду.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Some creatures can be tamed, granting you their full power, as you may have seen with Pets.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Некоторых существ можно приручить и получить всю их силу — возможно, ты уже знаком с питомцами.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: But most creatures cannot be tamed, so hunters extract what we call a Shard.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Но большинство существ не приручить, поэтому охотники извлекают то, что мы называем осколком.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Exactly. It represents the creature's biological footprint, its core attribute.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Именно. Это биологический отпечаток существа, его основное свойство.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: By using a Shard, you harness that unique power yourself.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Используя осколок, ты получаешь доступ к этой уникальной силе.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: It's better if you start hunting to find out for yourself.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Лучше начни охотиться и узнай всё сам.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Talk to Alan and buy your first hunting weapon to get started.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Для начала поговори с Аланом и купи своё первое охотничье оружие.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: It's better if you start Hunting yourself!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Лучше попробуй поохотиться сам!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: But first, you should go talk to Alan and get proper gear.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Но сначала поговори с Аланом и обзаведись подходящим снаряжением.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Perfect! You have your very first hunting weapon.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Отлично! У тебя появилось первое охотничье оружие.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: That's all you need to get started on your hunting journey.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Для начала охотничьего пути этого достаточно.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Head over to Oden, they'll teach you the basics of hunting.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Отправляйся к Одену за уроком основ охоты.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You'll find them north of the village!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ищи к северу от деревни!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: First you should talk to Oden, they will show you the basics of Hunting.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Сначала поговори с Оденом: там тебя познакомят с основами охоты.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Go find them North of the Village!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ищи к северу от деревни!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Wow!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ух ты!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You got your very first Combat Shard!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ты получил свой первый боевой осколок!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You can find all your Shards in your Hunting Box, inside your Hunting Skill Menu!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Все твои осколки хранятся в охотничьем ящике, в меню навыка охоты!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: But there are various types of monsters out there you can Hunt.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Но охотиться можно на самые разные виды чудовищ.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to Jaeger next!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Теперь поговори с Егерем!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You will find them close to the Loch.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ищи у озера Лох.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You already completed your training with Jaeger?
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ты уже закончил обучение у Егеря?

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You got your very first Water Shard!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ты получил свой первый водный осколок!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: It does!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Именно так!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: But that is still too early for you to learn.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Но об этом тебе пока рано узнавать.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You have to complete your training, with Auryon.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Нужно завершить обучение у Ауриона.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: They should be South of the Village.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ищи к югу от деревни.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to Auryon next!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Теперь поговори с Аурионом!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You managed to complete your Hunting training!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ты завершил обучение охоте!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You got your very first Forest Shard!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ты получил свой первый лесной осколок!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Combat, Water, and Forest are the only 3 types of Shards.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Осколки бывают только 3 типов: боевые, водные и лесные.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Dont ask me why, I have no idea!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Не спрашивай почему, сам не знаю!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Now you should finally learn what Shards are for.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Теперь пора наконец узнать, для чего нужны осколки.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to my assistant.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Поговори с моим помощником.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: No, not Pounce, my other assistant Kysha, right next to the Fusion Machine in the back.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Нет, не с Паунсом, а с другой помощницей — Кишей. Она сзади, рядом с устройством слияния.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to my assistant Kysha, right next to the Fusion Machine in the back.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Поговори с моей помощницей Кишей. Она сзади, рядом с устройством слияния.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You've mastered the fundamentals of hunting!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ты освоил основы охоты!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: At first, the attributes may seem weak, but over time they will grow stronger.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Поначалу свойства могут показаться слабыми, но со временем они станут сильнее.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: The more you syphon an attribute, the more powerful it becomes.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Чем чаще ты извлекаешь свойство, тем сильнее оно становится.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Hunters continue to discover new Shards every year.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Каждый год охотники открывают новые осколки.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Actually, I've got another gift for you...
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Вообще-то у меня есть ещё один подарок для тебя...

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: I guess I'm in a generous mood today.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Наверное, сегодня на меня нашла щедрость.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: I crafted this Cloak some time ago. It seems to grow stronger with every hunt.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Я сделал этот плащ некоторое время назад. Кажется, с каждой охотой он становится сильнее.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Use it to take your hunting skills to the next level!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Пусть он поможет тебе достичь новых высот в охоте!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Talk to me if you want to learn more about hunting or view your progress.
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Обращайся, если захочешь узнать об охоте больше или посмотреть свой прогресс.

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Very impressive!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Весьма впечатляет!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: I've seen worse!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Бывало и хуже!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You tried your best I guess!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Думаю, ты сделал всё, что мог!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Ah, the Hunting Toolkit!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: А, набор для охоты!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: An absolutely essential hunting item! It allows you to rapidly swap between your hunting tools!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Совершенно незаменимая вещь для охотника! Позволяет быстро переключаться между охотничьими инструментами!

records.speaker: David Hunterborough
records.source: [NPC] David Hunterborough: You should buy one sometime!
records.translation: [NPC] David Hunterborough: Стоит как-нибудь его купить!

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: We don't eat much.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Мы мало едим.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Sometimes we eat Odonatas.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Иногда едим стрекоз.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Yes.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Да.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Hi.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Привет.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: To collect Odonatas, you need to fly.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Чтобы ловить стрекоз, нужно летать.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Use the larvas to fly.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Используй личинок, чтобы летать.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Talk to Bugshopper, then show me a Larva Hook.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Поговори с торговцем жуками, потом покажи мне крючок из личинки.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Get a Larva Hook from Bugshopper.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Добудь крючок из личинки у торговца жуками.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Now use the hook.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Теперь используй крючок.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Find a larva in the branches.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Найди личинку на ветках.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Hook it until it relinquishes its SILK.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Цепляй её крючком, пока не отдаст ШЁЛК.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Then come back.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Потом возвращайся.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Hook it until it relinquishes its silk.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Цепляй её крючком, пока не отдаст шёлк.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Good.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Хорошо.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Do not eat the silk.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Не ешь шёлк.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Otherwise you cannot fly.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Иначе не сможешь летать.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Now go and bring back 6 Larva Silk.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Теперь принеси 6 шёлка личинки.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Bring me 6 Larva Silk.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Принеси мне 6 шёлка личинки.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Great.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Отлично.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: You may have noticed...
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Может, ты заметил...

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: You can use silk to create wires.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Из шёлка можно делать проволоку.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Silkwire.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Шёлковая проволока.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Use Silkwire to fly.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Используй шёлковую проволоку для полёта.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: With this stick.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Вот с этой палочкой.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Now talk to Bugshopper and show me an Odonata Bottle.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Теперь поговори с торговцем жуками и покажи мне бутылку для стрекоз.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Lost stick?
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Потерял палочку?

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Now is flying time.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Теперь пора летать.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Spot an Odonata out there.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Найди стрекозу.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: They are very small.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Они очень маленькие.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Lay out a Silkwire which crosses the Odonata.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Натяни шёлковую проволоку так, чтобы она пересекала стрекозу.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Use the Silkwire Stick on the Silkwire to fly.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Используй палочку из шёлковой проволоки на шёлковой проволоке, чтобы летать.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Then collect the Odonata using the Empty Odonata Bottle.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Потом поймай стрекозу пустой бутылкой для стрекоз.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: I am hungry. Please bring back the Bottled Odonata.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Я голоден. Принеси стрекозу в бутылке.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Lay out a Silkwire which crosses it.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Натяни шёлковую проволоку так, чтобы она её пересекала.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Please bring a Bottled Odonata.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Принеси стрекозу в бутылке.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Very very good.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Очень-очень хорошо.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Very tasty.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Очень вкусно.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Because few words do trick.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Потому что мало слов хватает.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: I taught you how to capture Odonatas.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Я научил тебя ловить стрекоз.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Now please bring back 8 Bottled Odonata.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Теперь принеси 8 стрекоз в бутылках.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: I am very hungry.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Я очень голоден.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: There is something in it for you if you do.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Тебе за это кое-что достанется.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Please bring me 8 Bottled Odonata.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Принеси мне 8 стрекоз в бутылках.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: So good.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Как хорошо.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: You are the best.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Ты лучший.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Take this belt.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Бери этот пояс.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: It's safer with it.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: С ним безопаснее.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Lost your belt?
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Потерял пояс?

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: That's unsafe.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Это небезопасно.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Thank you for the Odonatas.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Спасибо за стрекоз.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: I am not hungry anymore.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Я больше не голоден.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Come back when I am hungry again.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Приходи, когда я снова проголодаюсь.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: I am hungry.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Я голоден.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Please bring me 3 Bottled Odonata.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Принеси мне 3 стрекозы в бутылках.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: I will give you 5,000 Motes if you do.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Дам тебе за это 5,000 пылинок.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Thank you.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Спасибо.

records.speaker: Argofay Bughunter
records.source: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Here are the Motes.
records.translation: [NPC] Argofay Bughunter: Вот пылинки.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Oink.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Хрю.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: What, when? Oh.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Что, когда? Ох.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: How long have I been gone?
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Долго меня не было?

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I keep on forgetting about Sulphur...
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Вечно забываю о сере...

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Nowadays I live as a recluse, focusing on my work.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Теперь я живу отшельником и сосредоточен на работе.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I'm a writer, so I need calm to concentrate on my new novel.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Я писатель. Мне нужен покой, чтобы сосредоточиться на новом романе.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I really need to get back to work.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Мне очень нужно вернуться к работе.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: The name of my new novel? Hmm...
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Как называется мой новый роман? Хм...

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I haven't decided yet.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Ещё не решил.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I mostly write fictions. Because you helped me, I'll tell you some of the plot.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: В основном я пишу художественную прозу. За твою помощь немного расскажу о сюжете.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: The story takes place in a dystopian Crimson Isle where the lava of the Volcano is turning into water.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Это антиутопия о Багровом острове, где лава вулкана превращается в воду.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: We Piglins always dream of water. This book will be about showing that water also brings pain and struggle.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Мы, пиглины, вечно мечтаем о воде. Эта книга покажет, что вода тоже приносит боль и трудности.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Again...
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Снова...

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I get so absorbed by my work...
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Я так увлекаюсь работой...

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Time really flies when you work on something you love.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Когда занимаешься любимым делом, время летит незаметно.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Thanks for the Sulphur! I'll finish my new novel now.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Спасибо за серу! Теперь закончу новый роман.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: My new novel?
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Мой новый роман?

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: It's about an old hero that everyone still considers as the strongest.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Он о старом герое, которого все по-прежнему считают сильнейшим.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: But he himself knows very well that his prime is over and that his next fight will be his last.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Но сам он прекрасно знает: лучшие годы позади, а следующий бой станет последним.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: It's be a sad story about how the expectations of others can force you to do things that hurt you.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Это будет печальная история о том, как чужие ожидания заставляют нас вредить самим себе.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: My new novel is about someone who has a strange power that allows him to inspect the memories of others.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Мой новый роман о человеке со странной способностью заглядывать в чужие воспоминания.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: The first part shows him having fun with his powers and exploring ways to use memories to his advantage.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: В первой части он развлекается со своей силой и учится использовать чужие воспоминания себе на пользу.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: But one day he finds a strange character, and in their memories he sees things he should have never seen...
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Но однажды встречает странного незнакомца и видит в его памяти то, чего ему никогда не следовало видеть...

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: That's it! I won't tell you more than that!
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Всё! Больше ничего не расскажу!

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I'm currently working on a complex love story.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Сейчас я работаю над непростой историей любви.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: A smart and beautiful girl is forced to marry someone they have never met before.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Умную и красивую девушку вынуждают выйти замуж за человека, которого она никогда не видела.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: She's apprehensive at first but when she meets him they end up surpassing all expectations.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Поначалу она встревожена, но при знакомстве он превосходит все её ожидания.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: She falls in love quickly but he doesn't and for the first time in her life she has to deal with that emotional pain.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Она быстро влюбляется, а он — нет. Впервые в жизни ей приходится пережить такую душевную боль.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: It's a simple story but it touches a lot of interesting subjects.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: История простая, но затрагивает много интересных тем.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I'm writing a fictional story about Kaeman and his wife Sarah, before the Calamity.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Я пишу вымышленную историю о Каемане и его жене Саре до Катастрофы.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Most people know Kaeman as the Wither King, but I think it's important to remind people that he once was a human.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Большинство знает Каемана как Короля иссушителей. Но, по-моему, важно напомнить, что когда-то он был человеком.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: The tragedy of his life isn't very known. He had an idyllic relationship with his wife, up until their daughter was born.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: О трагедии его жизни мало кто знает. Их отношения с женой были идиллическими — до рождения дочери.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I'm trying to show how pain and sorrow turned this well respected man into an evil doer.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Я пытаюсь показать, как боль и горе превратили этого уважаемого человека в злодея.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: My new book is a different take on the battle royale stories.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Моя новая книга — необычный взгляд на истории о королевской битве.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Every 10 years there is a global tournament to the death with all the strongest warriors in the world.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Каждые 10 лет сильнейшие воины мира сходятся на всемирном турнире насмерть.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: The winner of the tournament becomes immortal.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Победитель турнира обретает бессмертие.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Every 250 years there is a special battle royale tournament with the previous 24 winners.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Каждые 250 лет проходит особая королевская битва между 24 предыдущими победителями.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: The twist is that those battle veterans are accustomed to their immortality, which has impacted their views and personalities over time.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Но есть подвох: эти ветераны уже привыкли к бессмертию, и оно со временем изменило их характеры и взгляды.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: It's a bit cheesy, but you gotta make money sometimes.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Немного банально, но зарабатывать ведь тоже надо.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: I think this new story will be my masterpiece.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Думаю, эта новая история станет моим шедевром.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: It's a thriller about a genius serial killer who's obsessed with framing police inspectors with his murders.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Это триллер о гениальном серийном убийце, который одержим идеей подставлять полицейских инспекторов, приписывая им свои убийства.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: But this time the inspector he framed escaped the justice system and hunts him down.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Но на этот раз подставленный им инспектор скрывается от правосудия и сам охотится за убийцей.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: It's an incredible battle of wits between two brilliant minds.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Невероятная интеллектуальная дуэль двух блестящих умов.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: Oink?
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: Хрю?

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: ✆ I'm pretty busy right now, sorry.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: ✆ Прости, сейчас я очень занят.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: ✆ I know you are worried about me but I'm feeling fine right now.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: ✆ Знаю, ты за меня волнуешься, но сейчас я чувствую себя хорошо.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: ✆ I need to finish my book.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: ✆ Мне нужно закончить книгу.

records.speaker: Sirih
records.source: [NPC] Sirih: ✆ Is this urgent? I'm working on my new novel at the moment.
records.translation: [NPC] Sirih: ✆ Это срочно? Я сейчас работаю над новым романом.

records.speaker: Kysha
records.source: [NPC] Kysha: David Hunterborough says you've completed your training.
records.translation: [NPC] Kysha: Дэвид Хантерборо говорит, что ты завершил обучение.

records.speaker: Kysha
records.source: [NPC] Kysha: Now, it's time to teach you the true purpose of hunting.
records.translation: [NPC] Kysha: Теперь пора объяснить тебе истинную цель охоты.

records.speaker: Kysha
records.source: [NPC] Kysha: Every Shard you collect goes into your Hunting Box, located in the Hunting Skill Menu.
